results.title: Qatar sends 15 buses to Senegal ahead of Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics
results.content: With just days to go before the start of the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, 15 buses gifted by Qatar arrived in the Senegalese capital. They're part of a Qatari initiative to support nations hosting international sporting events.

results.title: Ethiopia: At least 60 Christians killed in attacks in Oromia region
results.content: Religious authorities said all the victims were Christians but provided no further details about those responsible for the attacks.

results.title: Turkey: tornado kills at least four workers at Antalya construction site
results.content: At least four workers died when a tornado struck a construction site in Antalya, overturning accommodation cabins and a tower crane. Heavy rain also flooded roads in Istanbul.

results.title: IOC president arrives in Senegal ahead of the Youth Olympic Games
results.content: Zimbabwean Kirsty Coventry was welcomed by volunteers as Dakar prepares to host the first Olympic event in Africa.

results.title: Ukraine: firefighters battle flames and rescue dog from Kyiv ruins
results.content: A Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv killed one person and injured 15. Emergency workers rescued a dog from the rubble, while strikes damaged university buildings and a major bridge.

results.title: University students in The Gambia protest over poor campus conditions
results.content: Hundreds of students in Gambia's capital Banjul demonstrated on Monday against poor conditions at the nation's leading university. Echoing demands by students across Europe, the University of The Gambia's student union called for a mass mobilisation, but urged participants to remain peaceful.

results.title: Niger accuses Chad of deadly drone attack in which two civilians died
results.content: The military authorities say they have summoned the Chadian ambassador over the incident and are demanding compensation for the damage caused.

results.title: Israel: October 7 families remember victims as voters head to polls
results.content: In Tel Aviv, families affected by the 7 October 2023 attacks observed a moment of silence as polling stations were opening across Israel for the general election.

results.title: Harry Kane become first English footballer to win Ballon d'Or in 25 years
results.content: He is the first English player in 25 years to win the sport's most presitigious individual prize, beating Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal.

results.title: South African ambassador calls for talks to ease tensions with US
results.content: Roelf Meyer said Pretoria is seeking "direct dialogue" with Washington as it seeks to avoid exclusion from a key US-Africa trade deal.

results.title: France: crowds fill Marseille's Old Port in anti-racism protest
results.content: Hundreds of people gathered at Marseille's Vieux-Port on Monday evening to protest against racism following a deadly shooting near Paris. Police estimated the crowd at 800, while organisers put attendance at more than 1,000.

results.title: Human rights activists condemn alleged abduction of Tanzanian govt critic
results.content: Human rights activists condemn the alleged abduction of Tanzanian dissident and former opposition official, Twaha Mwaipaya, in Kenya. results.title: Moscow prepares to host African leaders for Russia-Africa Summit
results.content: African leaders are gathering in Moscow for a series of high-level meetings focused on strengthening ties with Russia and shaping the future of global energy cooperation.

results.title: Sudan: Soaring prices worsen food crisis [ Africanews Today]
results.content: Torn apart by war, Sudan is grappling with the consequences of the armed conflict on its economy and its people. In Omdurman, bread supplies are dwindling, and residents can no longer afford to buy it.

results.title: Russia: flames engulf buildings after Ukrainian drone attack in Voronezh region
results.content: At least two people were killed and 17 injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Voronezh region. Flames engulfed buildings, while falling debris struck a commuter train.

results.title: Dakar prepares to host the 2026, Youth Olympics Africa’s first Olympic event
results.content: The countdown is on in Dakar. With just days to go, construction crews are racing against the clock to prepare Senegal’s capital for a historic global sporting event.

results.title: Displaced families in Yemen live in dire humanitarian situation
results.content: Hundreds of displaced families from Yemen's Taiz and Lahj governorates are living in camps in Aden amid difficult living conditions and a continuing need for humanitarian assistance following a major Houthi offensive that started in September.

results.title: UK: Oxford Street pedestrianisation begins in central London
results.content: Pedestrians have taken over part of London's Oxford Street as a new traffic ban comes into force.

results.title: Egypt approves military support for Saudi Arabia amid escalating Houthi attacks
results.content: Egypt is moving closer to the regional conflict, after parliament approved military support for Saudi Arabia amid escalating Houthi attacks.

results.title: Fear and misinformation hamper Ebola response in DR Congo
results.content: In eastern Congo, fear and misinformation are complicating the Ebola outbreak. After losing her sister and father, 27-year-old Zawadi Kavira Musubao was told she had been poisoned. A pastor blamed evil spirits, while a traditional healer’s potion failed to help.

results.title: Sudan experiences massive power outages after RSF drone strikes
results.content: Sudan's paramilitary Rapid Support Forces launched a coordinated drone attack Monday against five power stations, causing mass power outages across the country's east, a government official told AFP.

results.title: Nurse killed, health worker injured in DR Congo Ebola attack
results.content: A nurse was killed and a health worker severely injured after being attacked while responding to an Ebola alert in Congo, according to the World Health Organisation.

results.title: Turkish football fans elated about Mohamed Salah's transfer to Trabzonspor
results.content: Fans in Turkey are very happy with Mohamed Salah's transfer from Liverpool to Turkey’s Trabzonspor. The club has gained in popularity following its signing of Egypt's star footballer.

results.title: Chris Brown avoids jail over London nightclub bottle attack
results.content: Grammy-winning singer Chris Brown avoided prison time Monday for beating a music producer with a tequila bottle at a London nightclub three years ago.

results.title: Ukraine: Russian strikes hit Odesa and Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
results.content: Russian overnight strikes injured four people in Zaporizhzhia and sparked fires in the Odesa region on Monday. Ukrainian emergency services said an industrial site was hit twice more as firefighters battled the flames.

results.title: Nigeria: 50 killed in bandit attack on Taraba village
results.content: The death toll from an attack by gunmen on a rural village in eastern Nigeria on Friday has risen to 50, survivors told AFP on Sunday, after more bodies were discovered.

results.title: Sudan’s bread crisis deepens as flour shortages and soaring prices hit families
results.content: Bread and meat are becoming unaffordable for families in Sudan. In Omdurman, soaring prices are pushing basic food beyond people’s reach. In Blue Nile state, authorities have approved two loaves of bread for 1,000 Sudanese pounds.

results.title: Nigeria evacuates Ebola patient to Switzerland, tracks 53 contacts
results.content: The only confirmed case in Nigeria of Africa's latest deadly Ebola outbreak was evacuated Monday by air from Abuja, the capital, to Switzerland, where she has citizenship. Nigeria has stepped up contact-tracing and screenings at airports.

results.title: Netanyahu faces voters in Israel's first election since October 2023 attacks
results.content: Israelis will vote Tuesday in the country’s first national election since Hamas’ October 7, 2023, attack, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s leadership, national security and the country’s future at the center of a deeply divisive campaign.
